title: The Bird With the Crystal Plumage
description: An American writer (Tony Musante) hunts for an elusive slasher after witnessing an attempted murder through the glass doors of a Rome art gallery.

title: Beast From Haunted Cave
description: A gold thief and his crew hole up in a skier's lodge and come across a scary monster covered in cobwebs.

title: Humanoids From the Deep
description: A fisherman (Doug McClure) and a scientist (Ann Turkel) fight back when mossy sea monsters assault women.

title: Lizzie Lazarus
description: Eli and Bethany carry Lizzie's corpse through the woods. They're on a hike toward a mythical zone they believe will bring the dead body back to life. But each of them is keeping a secret about Lizzie's life, and the circumstances behind her death.

title: Body Bags
description: Filmmaker John Carpenter introduces a trio of terror tales: "Unleaded," "Hair" and Tobe Hooper's "Baseball Man."

title: Nomads
description: Evil spirits haunt a French anthropologist (Pierce Brosnan) and inhabit the doctor (Lesley-Anne Down) who treats him.

title: The Stepfather
description: A Pacific Northwest teen (Jill Schoelen) suspects that her mother's (Shelley Hack) smiling new husband (Terry O'Quinn) is not what he appears to be.

title: #Manhole
description: Shunsuke Kawamura falls into a manhole one night before his wedding. Trapped, he uses a smartphone to escape as time runs out. Will he make it to his wedding?

title: The Bride With White Hair II
description: Only her lover (Leslie Cheung) can stop a vengeful witch (Brigitte Lin) and her female warriors from massacring enemies.

title: Hell of the Living Dead
description: Soldiers and an Italian newswoman (Frank Garfield) meet natives turned into zombies by leaked green smoke.

title: From Darkness
description: Park ranger Angelica enlists the help of her ex, Viktor, a dog handler, to search for a missing woman in a dangerous nature reserve in Sweden.

title: Meat Kills
description: To prove herself worthy of joining 'Animal Army' a radical activist group led by the fearless Nasha, Mirthe secretly films the horrors of a local pig farm. Prepared to free the pigs, the group returns the next day to find empty cages.

title: Butcher, Baker, Nightmare Maker
